## What this changes

- **`<sig-table>` list mode + `param-prefix`** (`web/src/elements/
  sig-table.ts`, `table-model.ts`, ADR-249): when the element wraps no
  `<table>` it builds its row model from top-level `ol`/`ul` items —
  filter, multi-facet chips, licence-aware CSV, `hidden`-row filtering
  and URL state identical to table mode; sorting surfaces as a toolbar
  "Sort by" menu and linked/interactive headers never get a nested
  control (`aria-sort` stays honest to the server sort when no
  client-side sort is active). `param-prefix` namespaces every
  controlled param per mount (`src.`/`iss.`/`tgt.`/`rob.`/`cmp.`/`dsrc.`/
  `ev.`/`lst.`), so multi-mount pages can't collide.
- **`data-facet-label-<dim>`**: a positional per-row label map — chip
  text shows the human name the row already renders while the machine
  value (e.g. the queue's GEOID-bearing place slug) stays the
  URL/filter key. Keeps the K14 NEW-8 no-ungrouped-digits sweep green.
- **One mount component** (`web/src/components/KitTable.astro`): emits
  the `<sig-table>` wrapper plus the page-local allow-listed
  `/_kit/sig-table.js` script tag (ADR-224's admission pattern). The T1
  module allow-list membership is unchanged — the rollout rides the one
  already-budgeted module on every surface.
- **The rollout**: `/sources/**` (the shared `SourcesTable` and the
  `/sources/<id>/` changelog/versions/dossiers/entities/issues/targets/
  robots tables), the dossier sources explorer, `/dossier/` (one
  list-mode mount over the grouped index), every `/watch/` list route,
  `/evidence/` artifact rows, and `/research-queue/` task + campaign
  cards — each row restating its own rendered fields as
  `data-facet-*`/`data-sort-*`/`data-licence`. Every filter/sort/facet
  stays a plain GET link with JS off; the place `<sig-typeahead>` over
  ≤200 KiB shards (50 KiB cap today) is already mounted on `/dossier/`
  and the site chrome.
- **CSS honesty fix** (`epistemic.css`): explicit `[hidden]` rule so the
  kit's DOM-preserving hide beats class-level `display:flex` on list
  rows.

## Test changes

- New `web/tests/e2e/t1-table-rollout.spec.ts` — harness list-mode
  tests (filter/facets/sort/`lst.` namespacing, URL restore, toolbar
  sort both directions, linked-header no-nesting) plus one rollout test
  per surface, axe WCAG 2.2 AA sweeps on `/dossier/` and
  `/research-queue/`, and the K0 failure leg (blocked `/_kit/` leaves
  every surface complete and inert).
- `acceptance-parity.spec.ts`: the SIG-DSRC-D09 row regex tolerates the
  mount's `data-facet-*` attributes (`data-source-id`-first contract
  unchanged — cells still compared verbatim to the twin).
- `page-budgets.json` `measured_gaps`: `/dossier/` totalInitialMaxBytes
  re-recorded 177,000 → 190,000 under D-P36.64-1 (honest +~6.8 KB wire
  for the required mount) and `/explore/` interactionLatencyMs 500 →
  600 under D-P35.51-3 (consecutive suite legs 508–576 ms; idle ≈259) —
  ratified ceilings untouched, reported every run, stale-row fails.
- Unit coverage: `dossier-index` facet/sort helpers.
